mapper.sql: select task_id, task_type, resource_id, resource_title, trigger_scene, task_status, result_json, error_msg, start_time, finish_time, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from ai_task
mapper.select: and task_type = #{taskType}and resource_id = #{resourceId}and resource_title like concat('%', #{resourceTitle}, '%')and trigger_scene = #{triggerScene}and task_status = #{taskStatus} order by task_id desc
mapper.insert: insert into ai_task(task_type, resource_id, resource_title, trigger_scene, task_status, result_json, error_msg, start_time, finish_time, create_by, create_time, remark) values(#{taskType}, #{resourceId}, #{resourceTitle}, #{triggerScene}, #{taskStatus}, #{resultJson}, #{errorMsg}, #{startTime}, #{finishTime}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.delete: delete from ai_task where task_id in #{taskId}
